name: Haimanti Dutta Ray

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Haimanti Dutta Ray writes poetry and prose. Her books include In Loving Memory, published in 2015, and The Circle of Life & Other Tales, published in 2018. In her own essay about her father, the painter Shyamal Dutta Ray, intimate recollections of family life sit beside an account of the artistic world she grew up around.

‘Herald in the Chill’, her poem in Kabita Live, welcomes winter with flowers, birds, woollens and cups of tea. Its literary allusions share space with aching bones and the pleasure of ice cream in cold weather. The result is an affectionate, lightly humorous invitation to find renewal in the season’s ordinary comforts.
